heading_en: Deemed Approval for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies of Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operators Adopting the Internal Management Model Approach
summary_ja: 特別金融商品取引業者向け告示の例により比率を算出している最終指定親会社が、届出により第250条の承認を受けたものとみなされる旨を定める。
summary_en: Allows an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that calculates its ratio under the Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operator notice and whose subsidiary holds an approval under that notice to file for, and be deemed to hold, approval under Article 250.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that is calculating the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio in accordance with the provisions of the Public Notice on the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio for Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operators pursuant to Article 4, paragraph (1), and that has as a Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. a person that currently holds the approval under Article 15, paragraph (1) of the Public Notice on the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio for Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operators (including a person deemed to have obtained approval under Article 2, paragraph (2) of the Supplementary Provisions of the Public Notice on the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio for Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operators) intends to calculate the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio pursuant to Article 3, that Ultimate Designated Parent Company may submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency a document stating the matters listed in the items of Article 251, paragraph (1), attaching the documents listed in the items of paragraph (2) of that Article.
An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has made the notification under the preceding paragraph is deemed to have obtained the approval under Article 250 on the day of that notification.
